cases.name: Dr. Olga Gennadyevna Korobovskaya
cases.about:
She was a Principal in the Dallas Independent School District at Downtown Montessori at Ida B. Wells Academy and a medical doctor in her native country of Russia. 

She studied to be a physician at Krasnoyarsk State Medical Academy in Krasnoyarsk, Russia. She became a science teacher at Thomas C Marsh Middle School in 2008She served as principal at Pebblecreek Montessori and assistant principal at Eduardo Mata Montessori.
